# `listagg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns
the concatenation of non-NULL input values, separated by the delimiter ordered by key.
If all values are NULL, NULL is returned.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
listagg(expr[, delimiter])[ WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY key [ASC | DESC] [,...])]
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- listagg, example 1
> SELECT listagg(col) FROM VALUES ('a'), ('b'), ('c') AS tab(col);
abc
```

```sql
-- listagg, example 2
> SELECT listagg(col) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col DESC) FROM VALUES ('a'), ('b'), ('c') AS tab(col);
cba
```

```sql
-- listagg, example 3
> SELECT listagg(col) FROM VALUES ('a'), (NULL), ('b') AS tab(col);
ab
```

```sql
-- listagg, example 4
> SELECT listagg(col) FROM VALUES ('a'), ('a') AS tab(col);
aa
```

```sql
-- listagg, example 5
> SELECT listagg(DISTINCT col) FROM VALUES ('a'), ('a'), ('b') AS tab(col);
ab
```

```sql
-- listagg, example 6
> SELECT listagg(col, ', ') FROM VALUES ('a'), ('b'), ('c') AS tab(col);
a, b, c
```

```sql
-- listagg, example 7
> SELECT listagg(col) FROM VALUES (NULL), (NULL) AS tab(col);
NULL
```
